A1.justification: Both PDFs describe FOCUS and provide readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and supplementary material. The appendix algorithm moves from page 15 to page 14 without losing content, supporting a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original classification experiments on three pathology datasets, component ablations, and foundation-model and language-model comparisons in Tables 1–2 and Figures 2–3.

after.justification: v2 retains the original classification results and component, foundation-model, and language-model experiments in Tables 1–2 and Figures 2–3.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same global redundancy removal, language-guided token selection, sequential compression, cross-modal aggregation, and cross-entropy training procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same TCGA-NSCLC lung subtyping, CAMELYON lymph-node metastasis classification, and UBC-OCEAN ovarian subtyping tasks. No evaluated dataset or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains mean, max, and attentive pooling plus TransMIL, DS-MIL, DTFD-MIL, WiKG-MIL, TOP-MIL, and ViLa-MIL. The foundation-model and language-model comparison sets in Section 4.3 also match.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains the dataset counts, 6:2:2 splits, 4/8/16-shot settings, patch preprocessing, CONCH features, optimization settings, and 80-epoch maximum. Balanced accuracy, AUC, and F1 remain the evaluation metrics.

E4.justification: The incremental component ablation in Table 2 and encoder and prompt-generator comparisons in Figures 2–3 are unchanged. Appendix A retains the same prompts and accompanying prompt analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report ten-fold cross-validation with distinct data samplings and mean plus standard deviation across folds. The uncertainty displays and repeated-evaluation descriptions remain unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–2 and Figures 2–3 retain the same results and rankings. For example, FOCUS's 16-shot AUC remains 0.972, 0.943, and 0.967 on TCGA-NSCLC, CAMELYON, and UBC-OCEAN, respectively.

T1.justification: Equations 1–10 and the mathematics in Algorithm 1 are unchanged. The added explanation of σi in Figure 1's caption identifies an existing cosine-similarity quantity; it introduces no new mathematical definition, derivation, or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about exploiting pathology foundation models, progressive visual compression, and superior or comparable few-shot classification performance.

C2.justification: Sections 4.2–4.3 and Appendix A.4 retain the same interpretations of performance, encoder alignment, and prompt quality. No substantive explanation, applicability boundary, or limitation is added or removed.

D1.justification: The abstract changes the code statement from a future release promise to reported availability at the same repository. Implementation settings, supplied prompts, and pseudocode remain unchanged. The PDFs establish this availability statement, but not the repository's contents or usability.

R1.justification: v2 adds six references to the existing Section 2 overview, including Context Matters, TAKT, MoME, Diagnose Like a Pathologist, and two polarization/virtual-staining studies. The surrounding discussion and positioning of FOCUS remain substantively unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 adds an acknowledgment, updates Lishuang Feng's affiliation, revises the code-release sentence, and clarifies Figure 1's caption. The scientific prose and section organization otherwise remain essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1's caption now explains σi. Algorithm 1 moves from its separate final page onto page 14, with the remaining appendix discussion arranged beneath it. Figure artwork and experimental table structures are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves clarity by explaining Figure 1's σi and improves reproducibility documentation by reporting code availability instead of a future release. The appendix remains complete after layout consolidation. These are limited gains: the method, empirical evidence, and scientific interpretations are unchanged, and repository usability cannot be assessed from the PDFs.
